card.name: Diablada
card.tagline: Bolivia's UNESCO-listed Devil Dance — Oruro Carnival's Lucifer faces off against the Archangel Michael, masked dancers in flames descending the Andean streets.
card.profile: The Diablada, also known as the Danza de los Diablos (English: Dance of the Devils), is an Andean folk dance performed in Bolivia, in the Altiplano region of South America, characterized by performers wearing masks and costumes representing the devil and other characters from pre-Columbian theology and mythology. combined with Spanish and Christian elements added during the colonial era.
card.insight: The first institutionalized Diablada dance squad was the Gran Tradicional y Auténtica Diablada Oruro, founded in Bolivia in 1904 by Pedro Pablo Corrales.
